formal_valuation_universe_policy: A formal blended target requires current official financial evidence, company-level operating-driver eligibility, and a complete auditable external target-price model. An explicit target with an undisclosed horizon may receive at most 10% external-anchor weight only after the company-level valuation gate passes.

rows.method: cycle-adjusted operating-driver EPS/PE with explicit year-end rerating constraint
rows.normalization: Civil-explosives parent-profit floor is CNY0.50/0.575/0.60bn; lithium normalized net contribution is CNY0.9/2.05/2.50 ten-thousand per tonne. Inventory gains and hedge P&L receive zero normalized credit.
rows.source_overlap: The base operating assumptions and CNY42 target come from the same Dongwu report; the broker anchor is not independent confirmation.
rows.action: 条件核心；基准情景不翻倍，牛市情景具备翻倍弹性
rows.evidence_quality: medium-high: official filings plus original broker PDF; H2 cash conversion and target horizon remain unverified
rows.validation_trigger: H2 net profit of at least CNY1.73bn, positive cash conversion, lithium shipment delivery, and no renewed hedge drag
rows.invalidation: lithium-price reversal, H2 profit below the bridge, inventory/hedge effects dominating profit, or operating cash flow remaining materially negative
